decision: Reject both whole-episode request enrichments. Historical source delivery increases but negative packets and protected ranks regress. Keep production capture, MiniLM, claims/evidence and release unchanged. Retain frozen raw-input fixtures and opt-in native capture projections for research.

validation.broader_tests: Skipped as requested; no production library/core/frontend changes.

interpretation: Retaining source information restores missing history matches, but naive enrichment also changes lexical admission and ranking. Renaming only the heading does not fix it. The lexical-only ablation reproduces all 11 changed negative cases but no protected-rank losses. Negative admission therefore is not solely a MiniLM cutoff effect; the six rank regressions appear only in the measured hybrid arm.
next_direction: Evaluate captured corrective actions and their evidence independently of requested intent. Keep provenance distinct from reusable claims; do not store a task request as proof of a repair. A future context channel needs its own precision/eligibility and lifecycle evidence before production admission.
